To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the anchoring system is a key factor in the structural behavior of the floating breakwater, as well as the wave direction.

The mooring line forces are higher in the anchoring system located at the bottom, while the forces in the anchoring systems located at the sides of the module are smaller.
